visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with gray-streaked hair sits at a mahjong table, resting his chin on his hand with a pensive expression. He wears a gray t-shirt and a dark bracelet. The table is a green mahjong surface with scattered tiles in the center and organized rows at the edges. (2) A second man wearing a blue baseball cap with a lightning bolt logo, glasses, and a white t-shirt leans into the frame, speaking animatedly. The background features a cream-colored acoustic foam wall panel and a simple office chair. (3) A blonde woman in a black ribbed top covers her nose with her hand, looking annoyed at the first man. A computer monitor showing colorful data graphs is visible behind her, suggesting a workplace setting. (4) The woman hands a blue-and-white package of Cellina cooling wipes to the man. Close-up shots highlight the product's '激凍' (Frozen) branding and penguin illustrations. The man opens the package and pulls out a large white wipe. (5) The man wipes his neck, shoulder, and arm with the wet sheet, looking refreshed. The woman holds up two additional versions of the product in pink and light blue packaging to show variety. (6) The man looks directly at the camera with a satisfied smile, holding the used wipe. The group resumes their mahjong game, with the man placing a tile on the table center.
